While memory costs are expected to easily be the largest expense in the iPhone 18 Pro's bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's what we know.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply deal with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

The leaker states that Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing approximately $250.

The leaker also mentioned that this is "undoubtedly one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

While there are currently no reliable figures disclosing the projected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, Apple has shared materials information for the device based on the cost breakdown of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, including how much recycled content is used.
